repos_data.description: CKAN is an open-source DMS (data management system) for powering data hubs and data portals. CKAN makes it easy to publish, share and use data. It powers catalog.data.gov, open.canada.ca/data, data.humdata.org among many other sites.

DataSphereStudio is a one stop data application development& management portal, covering scenarios including data exchange, desensitization/cleansing, analysis/mining, quality measurement, visualization, and task scheduling.
Extract structured data from web sites. Web sites scraping.

repo_meta_data.description: 🌀 AI-native framework for building data portals. Scaffold a full portal from a brief and load datasets in minutes with agentic skills — any backend (CKAN, GitHub, Frictionless).
